rationale: v1.80.1 already has released marker-position writes, position history and full-pair resume adoption that invalidates history. This repairs their overlap in one live card without a feature, stored field, server protocol or persisted Undo.

summary.ru: Возврат на страницу во время сохранения перемещения не лишает принятую позицию отмены из-за старого снимка.
summary.en: Returning to the page while a marker move is saved no longer loses the accepted move's Undo to an older snapshot.
